profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer at Nextivity Inc.
profile.summary:
Over 30 years of experience in software/algorithm development and systems level design and test in scientific applications using an object-oriented approach 

Experienced in all phases of software development life cycle including requirement specifications, level-of-effort analysis, design documents, code development, version control, and software test and release 

Development of image processing and digital signal processing algorithms 

Design and implementation of motion control and data acquisition systems on the PC 

Tools: C/C++, STL, Python, Git, Microsoft Visual Studio, MATLAB, LabVIEW, C#, Fortran, Visual Basic, and Excel/VBA 

Security Clearance: Secret

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Developed Embedded and application software for High Power 5G Mobile Routers 
Updated embedded software for the Scanning Receiver Site-Survey tool to work with new modem 
Fixed critical bugs in Public Safety DAS system 
Mentored junior team members in Software Engineering 
Redesigned software build system which reduced build time by an order of magnitude
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Systems · C (Programming Language) · Embedded Software · STM32 · C++ · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served as a senior member of a software team developing MIDS-JTRS Radios.
Worked with a team of software engineers using agile to develop and maintain software.
Ported existing radio waveform software to MIDS-JTRS Radio using C++.
Updated File Encryption scripts using Python.
Performed software development; fixed bugs and added features to existing code using C++.
Developed automation scripts for provisioning and testing MIDS-JTRS Radios using Python.
Worked with Production team to integrate automation scripts onto the Production floor.
Worked in classified lab with MIDS-JTRS Radios, instrumentation and support equipment.
Served as technical lead in software bug investigation.
Performed troubleshooting at customer site.
Utilized the following tools: C/C++, Python, Green Hills RTOS and Development Tools, Microsoft Visual. Code, JIRA, Crucible and Fisheye, and MS Office
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · LabVIEW · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Debugging Code · Algorithm Design · Cryptography · Automation · Field Work · C++ · Software Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served as a senior member of a software team developing Tactical Data Link (TDL) integration solutions.
Worked with a team of software engineers using agile project development to maintain software used as a Tactical Air Control Party (TACP) Close Air Support System (CASS).
Performed software development; fixed bugs and added features to existing code using C++.
Worked with military radios and test systems such as BOSS, MIDS-LVT, PRC-117F/G, and SADL in a laboratory environment.
Worked with systems engineering to develop system requirements.
Authored Software Design Documents (SDDs) and unit tests.
Peer reviewed software changes.
Utilized the following tools: C/C++/MFC, Microsoft Visual Studio 6.0 through 2010, Rational ClearQuest, Visio, and MS Office.
positions.insights: Skills: Debugging · Algorithms · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Field Work · C++ · Software Development

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
Served as lead developer and supervisor of a team of engineers which developed software for the analysis/simulation of semiconductor lithography tools.
Designed and developed: image analysis software, numerical algorithms, statistical analysis software, and Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs).
Translated customer requirements to product design and design specifications.
Assisted in the documenting of Software Requirement Specifications (SRS).
Provided project estimations.
Worked closely with Quality Assurance (QA) to develop test procedures and performed testing.
Utilized Microsoft Visual Studio 6.0 through 2010; C/C++/MFC and C#, MATLAB, Lahey Fortran, LabVIEW, Visual Basic, Visio for software architecture, Excel, and VBA for data analysis.

Manufacturing Engineer:
Took on additional role of Manufacturing Engineer as company downsized; involved in the manufacturing of high precision optics in a clean room environment.
Designed and developed the Control System for a Fully Automated Inspection Station including PCI Bus, RS-232, and USB interfaces.
Responsible for upkeep and repair of all clean room and manufacturing equipment including an overlay reader, mask aligner, and interferometer.
positions.insights: Skills: LabVIEW · Numerical Analysis · Manufacturing Engineering · Fortran · C (Programming Language) · Algorithm Design · C++ · Software Development · Digital Image Processing

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served as head of new software development; led efforts to convert software from C to C++.
Developed real-time software for fully automated parts handling machines; software development included integrating vision testing, multi-axis robotics, and electrical testing.
Developed new object-oriented software for miniature (< 200 micron) die tape and reel handling machines.
Worked in clean room environments installing systems at customer sites.
Utilized Microsoft C/C++ 7.0.
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Vision · C (Programming Language) · Algorithm Design · Automation · C++ · Motion Control

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
Served as Software/Systems Engineer and Project Manager for design and development of Laser Ablation Tools; served as Lead Engineer for deployment of laser ablation tools onto factory floor.
Developed software and control systems of excimer laser ablation tools.
Worked on the development and integration of the following tool subsystems: excimer lasers in an oscillator- amplifier configuration, excimer optics, laser beam stabilization, and multi-axis robotics.
Utilized Microsoft C/C++ 7.0, LabVIEW, Microcontrollers, and Visual Basic.
positions.insights: Skills: LabVIEW · Machine Vision · Optics · Excimer Lasers · C (Programming Language) · Automation · Motion Control · Semiconductor Lasers

positions.title: Research Engineer
positions.description:
Developed prototype devices for medical infusion and vital sign monitoring devices, including design and development of software and electronics for computer automation and data acquisition.
Developed algorithms which included digital signal processing, interrupt driven data acquisition and motion control.
Worked on product development for microwave-based sensors for flow rate measurement, air-in-line 
detection, and pressure sensing for medical infusion devices.
Worked on product development for Infiltration Detection which included field studies, data analysis, and digital signal processing algorithm development.
Utilized Microsoft C 6.0, LabVIEW, LabWindows, Mathcad, QuickBasic, and Excel.
positions.insights: Skills: LabVIEW · Algorithms · Mathcad · Simulations · C (Programming Language) · Automation · Microwave Systems · Data Acquisition · Digital Signal Processing
